summary: Inserts or appends a node a2 into a singly-linked list rooted at this+0x90 (dword index 36). First the three source fields this+0x40, this+0x98 and this+0x9C are copied into the new node at the same offsets. When the flag a3 is nonzero the node is prepended: the old head becomes a2's next pointer (dword index 35, offset 0x8C) and a2 becomes the new head. When a3 is zero and the list is non-empty the code walks to the tail following next pointers and calls FieldSetterAt0x8c to link it; when the list is empty a2 becomes the first node. Finally the node counter at this+0x94 is incremented and the new count is returned.

Branch on the flag a3: nonzero selects the prepend path, zero selects the append path.
Prepend: chain the old head into a2's next-pointer slot (dword index 35) and store a2 as the new head at this+0x90.
Append path: when the list head at this+0x90 is non-null, walk to the tail; when it is null the list is empty.
Traverse the list following the next-pointer field at dword index 35 (offset 0x8C) until a node with a null next pointer is found.
Call FieldSetterAt0x8c on the tail node to set its next pointer (offset 0x8C) to the new node a2.
Empty-list append: store a2 as the first node at this+0x90.
Increment the node counter at this+0x94 and return the new count.
